title: Normalize moved Java helper body indentation after deep-nested extraction
wanted_capability: After extracting a deeply nested Java block into a class-level helper, the moved method body should be reindented relative to the new helper declaration, either in the extractor or in java.hygiene.
missing_primitive: method-body reindent hygiene for extracted Java helpers
fallback_used: Accepted compile-passing cosmetic indentation residue and recorded it as structural/hygiene debt.
notes: Still open after the var-resolution/nested-region tranche. Compile-passing helper body indentation residue remains a separate hygiene/extractor polish item. The calculation reprobe reproduced the issue after successful extraction and hygiene: helper body indentation stayed at source nesting depth.
resolution_note: Reopened after the calculation reprobe. The extractor strips common whitespace in simple deep-nested selections, but a selected range with mixed active code and shallower commented-out lines still produced helper-body indentation residue.
